if: the transaction is an import of services
then: the transaction IS a supply, whether or not it is in the course or furtherance of business
note: The business-purpose test in s.7(1)(a) does NOT apply here. This is the clause most often missed: an import of services for consideration outside any business is still a supply.

evidence.quote: import of services for a consideration whether or not in the course or furtherance of business
evidence.extraction_note: The clause ends ';[and]12' in the extraction — an editorial amendment marker carried down to footnote 12. The quote stops at 'business' to stay clear of it.
